amendment-2-2025.content: privileged_case_file: Amendment 2 increases the quarterly minimum royalty floor, shifts reasonable third-party audit costs to the licensee if underreporting exceeds 7%, and clarifies that cure starts only upon written audit deficiency notice sent to legal and finance contacts listed in the notice appendix.

artifact-telemetry-1.verification_note: evidence_attachment: Product operations export aligns with deployment records and contradicts the Legacy Shipment Basis worksheet tab used in the submitted report.

artifact-prior-art-brochure-1.verification_note: evidence_attachment: Publication date, distributor footer, and archived trade-show scan are consistent with public circulation before the asserted patent filing window.
